lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against Israel's prophets who speak out of their own imagination and have seen nothing.
God says Israel's prophets are like wolves among the ruins and did not restore the wall for battle.
The prophets say "Peace" when there is none, and God says rain, hail and wind will topple the whitewashed wall.
God will level the whitewashed wall, the city will fall, and the prophets who whitewashed it will be gone.
God condemns the women who sew magic charms to ensnare souls, and they profaned Him for pieces of silver.

wrong_details.true: handfuls of barley and scraps of bread
